description: This file defines the interface for a ConnectorType class and a ConnectorController class within the WPEFramework RPC namespace. It includes external references to IPC server proxies, manages communication channels, and handles controller lifecycle management.

classes.name: ConnectorController
classes.description: Manages a singleton instance controlling a Core::IUnknown interface, with methods to announce, revoke, and access the controller.

classes.name: ConnectorType
classes.description: Template class managing communication channels via nested Channel class, providing methods to acquire interfaces, access communicators, and manage operational state.

methods.name: DefaultInvokeServer
methods.description: Returns a default IPC server proxy.

methods.name: WorkerPoolInvokeServer
methods.description: Returns a worker pool IPC server proxy.
